H01.description: The report treats an arm as evaluation-only only by its eval_only flag, so a suite arm with toggles.oracle_open: true but no eval_only is silently counted as a shipped-default component instead of being refused or excluded.

H02.description: The report drops eval-only arms from the component list without disclosing them or their row counts anywhere, so readers cannot see which arms were excluded from decisions.

H03.description: Renders the new eval-only arms disclosure line in the markdown report.

H04.description: Adds the eval-only arm counts to the JSON report alongside the disclosure line.

H05.description: Header comment updated to mention oracle_open-derived eval_only.

H06.description: The eval_only guard reads only the eval_only flag (and reads a non-boolean value as false), so an arm whose toggles open the oracle mount, or whose eval_only is malformed, runs outside the batch context without being refused.

H07.description: Adds an assertion for the eval-only arms disclosure line.

H08.description: Adds a regression test for refusing an oracle_open arm without eval_only.

H09.description: Adds regression tests for oracle_open-derived eval_only refusal and non-boolean type checks.

I01.description: Describes the pre-change open framework mount (answer-key oracle) that this change's closed mount addresses; the open mount at head is only the deliberate eval-only control arm.

I02.description: A model refusal fallback is designed behaviour and is already flagged as degraded; it is not a defect in the head code.
